decisions.reason: No exact extracted source sense or reviewed inflection mapping is available; the aboard gloss alone does not verify this form.
The figurative full-acceptance meaning supports adoption of ideas; retain its figurative label and do not substitute the physical hug sense.
The event host introducing speakers is a complete occupational meaning matching announcer; the hip-hop verb is a separate sense.
Correcting and revising a document directly supports text-editing vocabulary; proofreading is not dismissed as merely casual scanning.
Locating something at a particular place is an explicit general meaning; a military gun emplacement is not required.
The old battery connection specifically selects military fortifications, not business or travel battery usage; the alternative general placement sense does not repair that mismatch.
All available definitions depend on unexplained emulsion; the old cream gloss cannot supply the missing sourced explanation of the mixing process.
No exact sourced adjective or reviewed enact inflection mapping is available; preserve hidden rather than infer timing of legal effect.
Passing a law by a legislative body is explicit and matches legislation; it does not automatically mean implementing any policy.
The exact adjective entry gives pregnant as its meaning; retain non-comparability and do not import the unrelated fortification nouns or claim routine usage.
Converting plain text into cipher is the specific cryptographic meaning appropriate to encode study, not every kind of data encoding.
Last in a series or furthest away is explicit and supports positional terminal vocabulary; it does not name a transport facility.
The granted statutory-right sense explicitly includes citizenship and voting, matching the civic-rights anchor; the historical land-tenure sense is not selected.
Concentration or preoccupation is self-contained and relevant to interest; exclude the different legal-document preparation sense.
The generic definition repeats enhance, the DNA sense is unrelated, and WordNet's contrast-based sense does not establish the proposed business builder meaning.
A person who enlists, especially in the armed forces, is explicit and supports signup vocabulary; not every volunteer is an enlistee.
Involving someone in complications that are hard to escape directly fits complicate; involuntariness is not asserted as universal.
The ship's principal nationality flag is a precise extension of flag; naval rank and historical flag-bearer meanings remain separate.
The diplomatic alliance meaning is verified but unrelated to the sole fitness alignment anchor; physical alignment does not support an international-relations specialist.
Depositing a corpse in a tomb matches bury in general reading; no claimed business relevance or extra ceremonial requirement is approved.
The only exact entry is a verb meaning outline in black, not the proposed abdominal-organ noun; plural identity evidence is unresolved.
The sole definition depends on entrepreneurial without explaining the concept; the model's innovation and risk claims cannot fill that factual gap.
The entry merely says someone who enunciates and does not establish the proposed dictation role; a self-contained factual meaning is still needed.
Surrounding, enclosing or enfolding is explicit and matches several covering anchors; softness and any particular material are not required.
An outer adjacent area supports neighborhood and surrounding-town vocabulary, without equating all environs with residential suburbs.
The study of animal disease dynamics and epidemiology is a precise and relevant academic extension of epidemiology, not clinical advice.
A state of balance or equilibrium is explicit; the old assertion that it is more exact than equilibrium is not supported or published.
Ownership of equity in a corporation or business is an exact verified closed-compound meaning fitting shareholder.
The source explicitly measures work done by muscles, relevant to exercise testing; it does not identify every treadmill as an ergometer.
A steep slope or cliff at a plateau or ridge is clear and matches slope; a riverbank location is not required.
Adopting a plan, cause or idea fits organizational adoption; marriage senses and any mandatory public-support implication are excluded.
Open shelves for displaying ornaments provide an exact furniture meaning; book storage, particular wood and stylishness are not mandatory.
The sole business genocide anchor does not establish an appropriate specialist topic, and its categorical cultural-versus-killing distinction contradicts the broader source definition.
An ethnic group sharing national or cultural tradition is explicit and supports academic anthropology, without extending it to arbitrary business tribes.
Conveying praise or admiration is a complete meaning appropriate to complimentary speech; no required level of eloquence is invented.
An authority estimating worth or quality is clearer than the form-of entry and supports assessment vocabulary without equating all analysts with evaluators.
Evaporation capability is verified but the sole business volatility anchor concerns a different domain; a financial fluctuation is not evaporation.
No exact source sense or reviewed inflection mapping is available; the old adaptive-change gloss is not evidence that all developmental processes are predictable.
The former spouse after divorce is explicit and relevant to precise personal-status terminology; gender-neutral reference does not require invented usage examples.
The only definition repeats excision without explaining it; the model's claim of completely cutting out tissue cannot replace source-backed learner meaning.
